dedupe_keys.name: heew hierarchical arizona energy pv emissions and weather data

description: The HEEW team releases hourly energy, photovoltaic output, emissions and weather tables for 147 buildings, four aggregated communities and their Arizona region from 2014 through 2022. The Figshare version-one deposit has a public ZIP under CC BY 4.0, and its own metadata states 11,987,328 records and 13 variables. Energy fields cover electricity, heat and cooling; weather fields include temperature, humidity, wind and precipitation. The data can calibrate building load or community capacity-planning simulations with a building model such as model-energyplus after matching building identifiers and hours. A caveat is that the published cleaning workflow imputes missing observations and corrects anomalies, so the tables are not an untouched meter record. Net greenhouse-gas emissions are derived using energy and PV assumptions, not directly measured at every building. The geographic sample is one campus-linked region, not a national building-stock survey. I read Figshare metadata and the article Data Records statement; I did not download the ZIP, inspect each CSV or reproduce the imputation.
